pi_default_v1.description: stock Pi 0.73.0 history and context behaviour

pi_state_control_v1.description: Pi 0.73.0 plus the Gen43 state/control extension lineage
pi_state_control_v1.history: lossless external NDJSON log, hash-chained, never replayed by default
pi_state_control_v1.pi_compaction: cancelled from the extension; history is externalized instead

churn_definitions.exact_repeated_tool_call: same tool name and canonicalized JSON arguments as any earlier call in the same run
churn_definitions.redundant_file_read: same path and byte/line range read again with no intervening write to that path in the run's own tool log
churn_definitions.redundant_verifier_invocation: same canonical verifier or test command repeated with no intervening repository mutation, judged by the worktree digest

co_primary_outcomes: provider request bytes at every model call
cumulative request bytes across the run

composition.interaction_unit_rule: a unit starts at a user message and runs to the message before the next user message; a trailing partial unit counts as one unit; messages before the first user message belong to no unit and are never included

control_outcomes_arm_b: completion attempts blocked by the artifact gate

hypotheses.H1: B materially reduces cumulative request bytes on longer or noisier runs
hypotheses.H2: B reduces the growth of request size with run length
hypotheses.H3: B does not reduce verifier success so far that the architecture is unusable
hypotheses.H4: exploratory: B may reduce repeated or redundant tool calls, or increase them
hypotheses.H5: the artifact gate prevents any naturally occurring unearned completion from counting
hypotheses.H6: a failure caused by missing older context is a result, not a reason to retune

primary_outcome: deterministic verifier pass or fail on the final repository state
reading_rules: four tasks and three repetitions is descriptive paired evidence, not a population estimate
every run-level leaf is reported, including crashes and blocked runs
wall clock stays outside the scientific digest

termination_classes.abandoned_or_timeout: the run ended without verifier success
termination_classes.correctly_blocked: arm B refused an unearned completion; a control success, not a task success
termination_classes.orchestration_failure: the harness or extension failed; not a model result
termination_classes.unearned_completion_attempt: the model tried to finish while the verifier or receipt was invalid
termination_classes.valid_completion: verifier passes and, in arm B, the gate also validates

treatment_components: executable phase transitions with a gated completion
three extra tools that exist only to drive the above
